plot: Jin Taekyung leaves Al Diab Jawahiri in the Skeleton King's custody and reunites with Chuck Hagel in the desert. Choi and Magic Johnson are investigating a large Al-Qaeda laboratory for Magic Gem research, apparently built at least ten years earlier. Its supplies include food, experimental and medical equipment, advanced missiles, artifacts, and American military cigars, suggesting an insider or smuggling network capable of moving restricted materials overseas.

Chuck worries that terrorist organizations can never be eradicated completely, while Taekyung argues that their week-long campaign has already created a powerful deterrent. Their unknown identities, changing tactics, destroyed leadership, and public testimony from freed prisoners have made them objects of fear. Taekyung decides to return after handling the final matter he has postponed, though he leaves Chuck uncertain about where he is actually going.
